name: Deep links (URL scheme)
description: Opens a specific screen from a custom URL scheme (app-name://screen/id) through one router that parses links into typed routes.
usage: Create one `DeepLinkRouter` at the app root and attach `.onOpenURL { router.open($0) }`. Observe `router.pending` in the root view: switch to the tab or push the screen for `.screen(name)` or `.item(screen:id:)`, then call `router.consume()`. Build links to share with `DeepLink.item(screen: "orders", id: order.id).url`. The scheme is the lowercased app name.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify deep-links` on a Mac with XcodeGen.
